caseName: Washington Dredging & Improvement Co. v. Kinnear
caseNameFull: Washington Dredging & Improvement Company, in Error v. George Kinnear and Angie Kinnear, his Wife John R. Kinnear and Leta Kinnear, his Wife
summary: In error to the Supreme Court of the State of Washington.
attorneys: Mr. W. F. Hays for the plaintiff in error., Mr. George B. Cole, Mr. George E. de Steiguer and Mr. W. V. Tanner for the defendants in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction upon the authority of Washington Dredging & Improvement Co. v. Washington, 231 U. S. 742; Washington Dredging & Improvement Co. v. Washington, 235 U. S. 688.
